body:
## Why

Consumer sync PR stranske/Ready#573 (also stranske/Doc-Lineage#26) has unresolved bot review threads on two manifest-synced paths whose upstream sources live in Workflows:

1. `templates/consumer-repo/.github/workflows/agents-81-gate-followups.yml` — runner dispatch debounce treats any `completed` record on the same `(pr, head_sha, provider)` as productive, but #3433 requires counting task deltas; a no-commit run that advances task state must not burn the debounce key.
2. `tools/embedding_provider.py` — blank inputs are filtered out of the returned vector list, breaking the one-vector-per-input contract exercised by consumer tests.

## Scope

Fix both upstream sources in Workflows main so maint-68 sync regeneration outdates the consumer review threads.

## Non-Goals

- Implementing unrelated keepalive-loop behavior beyond the reservation-bound productivity semantics required here.
- Changing consumer PR bodies or merging consumer sync PRs from this issue.

## Tasks

- [x] In `scripts/runner_lib/core.py`, extend `should_dispatch` / `record_completion` so a completed dispatch is productive when the head changed or `tasks_completed_delta > 0`.
- [x] Add regressions in `tests/scripts/test_runner_lib.py` proving zero task delta preserves bounded retry and positive task delta marks completion productive.
- [x] In `tools/embedding_provider.py`, preserve index-aligned output for blank inputs (delivered on `main` by `6d0f3cd0`).
- [x] Cover five inputs including blanks and assert five vectors in `tests/tools/test_embedding_provider.py` (delivered on `main` by `6d0f3cd0`).
- [x] Run `./scripts/sync_templates.sh` and verify a second run is idempotent.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `python -m pytest -q tests/scripts/test_runner_lib.py tests/scripts/test_runner_completion_receipts.py tests/workflows/test_keepalive_task_progress.py tests/workflows/test_keepalive_workflow.py tests/workflows/test_workflow_agents_consolidation.py tests/workflows/test_keepalive_authority_delivery.py tests/workflows/test_github_api_retry_standard.py tests/tools/test_embedding_provider.py` passes (337 tests).
- [x] `./scripts/sync_templates.sh`, `python scripts/validate_template_sync.py`, and `python scripts/validate_template_completeness.py` pass; a second sync reports all files already in sync.
- [x] Deliberate-break gate for debounce: forcing the positive task-delta verdict false fails `test_completed_task_delta_marks_unchanged_head_productive`; restoration returns the suite to green.
- [x] Deliberate-break gate for embeddings: restoring blank filtering fails `test_embedding_preserves_blank_positions_and_generator_order` for OpenAI (two vectors returned instead of five); restoration passes both provider variants.

## Implementation Notes

PR #3577 carries the debounce implementation and workflow/template transport. The embedding half was already present on the selected `main` base at commit `6d0f3cd0`, and was re-verified during #3577 materialization.
